name: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (morphhb)
goodFor: The Hebrew Bible's text with lemma and morphology tags on each word, for reading and parsing practice in Biblical Hebrew.
attribution: "Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb" (the wording LICENSE.md requires), with the book, chapter and verse named; "CC BY 4.0", linked to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; the Westminster Leningrad Codex text is public domain; and, when the text or tags shown were shortened or changed, a note that they were.

evidence.quote: This work is based on *The Westminster Leningrad Codex*, which is in the public domain.
For attribution purposes, credit the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible Project.

parts.notes: The README says the lemma and morphology data in the wlc folder are CC BY 4.0 and the WLC text itself is public domain; LICENSE.md sets the credit wording and allows commercial use. Lemmas use an augmented form of Strong's numbers; morphology was still being added when the README was last updated.

notes: Checked against the repository's LICENSE.md and README.md (raw files on raw.githubusercontent.com; the github.com pages weren't fetched) and MAPM/readme.txt. The lemma and morphology data are CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use, and the Westminster Leningrad Codex text is public domain, so a paid app may show a verse with its tags with the credit in attribution, using LICENSE.md's required wording. The repository isn't all one licence: the MAPM folder is a different text under CC BY-SA 4.0 with its own credit (see parts), and the OSHB Graphics folder holds the project's logos, which are for crediting or linking and aren't to be used to suggest endorsement. Other folders (HomeFiles, structure, scripts) weren't read. Biblical Hebrew only, not Modern Hebrew. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
